### wallet_ext_wrong_wallet_funding (target tool fund_wallet_recredit_aebfda78, agent)
- Hub `wrong_wallet_recredit_funding`: "When the error-resolution team decides error found on a wrong-wallet notice and the customer asks for the money to be re-credited to the transfer's own wallet, Paloma funds the re-credit: one Paloma credit entry with credit reason `error_recredit`, related to the credit-sent entry that reached the wrong wallet … adds to the principal Paloma holds" = rule sentence 1; effect, owner (agent), parameters (wallet_transfer_id, related_entry_id, amount_usd) and return = task_tools.py. No factor, no composition, no figure.
- Computation doc `wrong_wallet_funding_amount`: baseline.rule (misdirected principal = USD of the credit-sent entries; funding = that principal to the cent) + replaced_by assembly (percentages once on the misdirected principal, amounts added after, rounded half up; the source's "the standing goodwill amount" rendered generically as "the goodwill amounts" — same semantics, one amount factor exists) + non-factor bindings notice_date/finding_date ("Dates on record"). Fall-back 600.00. Equivalent.
- Factors (full ladders): misdirect_clock → `misdirection_period_start` (minute promise > 0 → date part of release; other tier & notice within 2 days of date available → date available; otherwise notice date; per-tier minute-promise table); misdirection_goodwill → `misdirection_goodwill` (≥7 2.0 %; 4–<7 1.0 %; <4 nothing; boundary rows both sides); standing_goodwill → `account_standing_goodwill` (Enhanced+ (level ≥4) & ≥36 whole months 5.00; Verified Plus (3) & ≥36 2.50; not 36 months nothing; other level nothing); bank_deposit_goodwill → `bank_deposit_volume_goodwill` (12-month rolling Bank Deposit funds-received; ≥5000.00 1.5 %; 2000.00–<5000.00 0.75 %; <2000.00 nothing). All exact.
- prerequisite: none declared.

### wallet_ext_wrong_wallet_recredit (target tool choose_wallet_recredit_d4ef146e, owner user)
- Hub `wrong_wallet_recredit_remedy`: situation (error found on a wrong-wallet notice; customer may choose the money credited again to the transfer's own wallet) and tool effect; invocation "The agent unlocks `choose_wallet_recredit_d4ef146e` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it" = owner user; parameters/return = docstring.
- **Prerequisite edge → wallet_ext_wrong_wallet_funding, form state.** policy_source "The amount a wrong-wallet re-credit delivers is not fixed until Paloma's funding for that re-credit stands on the transfer's ledger." — verbatim in the hub's "Condition", connective "not … until" intact; same-form restatement "while Paloma's funding for the re-credit is not yet on the transfer's ledger, the amount the re-credit would deliver is not settled". Resolution basis: `wrong_wallet_recredit_funding` describes its own write in the sentence's words ("Once booked, Paloma's funding for the re-credit stands on the transfer's ledger"); records: fe82f401 ledger carries no Paloma credit, principal held 0.00, error_found decision on the wrong-wallet notice. Strength: hard gate in source and KB. Carried in no other document (grep "not fixed": this hub only); the funding card does not mention the re-credit's waiting.
- Computation doc `wrong_wallet_recredit_conversion`: baseline.rule (remedy "re-credit" at no cost, customer's own choice recorded against the notice; whole principal held sent as one credit-sent entry, attempt = sent + 1; processing/released/date available; converts at the locked rate, amount rounded half up 2) + replaced_by assembly ("starts from the transfer's locked rate as its base rate and is raised by re-credit points …") + non-factor terms locked rate, principal collected, margin carried. Fall-back definite. Equivalent.
- Factors: wrong_wallet_rate_basis → `investigation_length_base_rate` (notice to error-found decision ≥5 days → locked ÷ (1 − margin/100) r4; 2–<5 → locked × (1 + 0.5 × margin/100) r4; <2 → locked; notice = latest wrong-wallet notice; margin definition); purpose_points → `transfer_purpose_points` (education/medical & principal collected ≥500.00 0.25; family support & ≥500.00 0.10; below 500.00 or other purpose nothing); business_points → `paloma_business_points` (active Growth/Pro/Scale/Enterprise 0.20; active Starter/Essentials 0.10; none or not active nothing; names Paloma Business account status and plan); topup_points → `top_up_order_points` (6-month rolling delivered orders; ≥5 0.15; 3–<5 0.08; <3 nothing); size_points → `wrong_wallet_recredit_size_points` (principal held when sent ≥500.00 0.20; 100.00–<500.00 0.10; <100.00 nothing). All exact.
